field_meanings.accessible_for_task: At least one usable access or transport method exists for the stated group or cargo within the task time window; one blocked route does not prove all routes blocked.
field_meanings.ready_for_task: Currently ready, or explicitly ready by the required start, for the stated use; reputation, equipment ownership or beginning preparation alone does not confirm readiness.
field_meanings.catering_permitted: The kind of catering required by the task is permitted; limited snacks or unrelated food permission are not automatically sufficient.
field_meanings.group_capacity_sufficient: Can accommodate the full group size specified by the task for its intended use; historical attendance alone is not current capacity confirmation.

note: Manual task vocabulary supplied equally to both arms; representation-assisted screening, not automatic schema discovery.
